key.name: device-path
key.description: No longer used. Daemon now listens on all devices.

key.name: ptt-key-code
key.description: Raw Linux evdev keycode for the push-to-talk key. This is the kernel keycode, not the XKB keycode (XKB = evdev + 8). Default 58 = KEY_CAPSLOCK.

key.name: is-active
key.description: Whether the push-to-talk daemon is currently running.

key.name: ptt-sound-enabled
key.description: Play a Discord-style click sound when the PTT key is pressed and released.
